svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.20.17.2 Reinforcement for Flat Insulating Concrete Form Walls
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.20.17.2 Reinforcement for Flat Insulating Concrete Form Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.20 MASONRY AND INSULATING CONCRETE FORM WALLS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE GROUND
Reinforcement for Flat Insulating Concrete Form Walls

g.text: One 10M bar not more than 300 mm
from the top of the wall, (1)(a)(i)
Vertical bars interrupted by an opening:
not more than 600 mm from each side, (3)
Above-grade flat ICF wall, exterior form shown
Horizontal bars (cut ends) and vertical bars
placed in the middle third of the wall

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Horizontal reinforcement in above-grade flat
ICF walls
(a) consists of (i) one 10M bar placed not more
than 300 mm (11 13/16″) from the top of the wall,
and (ii) 10M bars at 600 mm (23⅝″) o.c., and (b)
is placed in the middle third of the wall
section.
Vertical reinforcement in above-grade flat ICF
walls
(a) consists of 10M bars at 400 mm (15¾″) o.c.,
and (b) is placed in the middle third of the wall
section.
Vertical reinforcement required by Sentence
(2) and interrupted by wall openings is placed
not more than 600 mm (23⅝″) from each side of
the opening.
Drawn: reinforcement red and dashed where hidden in the concrete. Bar layout and opening size are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.20.17.2. (page 9-153)
